recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, high-contrast portrait of a male figure in western attire leaning against a weathered wooden barn wall, featuring heavy textural overlays and large, distressed sans-serif typography that overlaps the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated with background through overlapping typography
High contrast between cool-toned wood and warm skin tones
Textural harmony between weathered wood, rusted metal, and distressed lettering
Verticality of the subject echoed by the vertical strokes of the display type
coreInvariants: Distressed, eroded texture applied to all white typography
Desaturated color palette with emphasized blues and browns
Subject centrally positioned but looking downward

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male figure, centered vertically, scaled to occupy the middle third of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, distressed display name spanning the horizontal center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/hat, moves down the body to the large text, then follows the text horizontally across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight framing with minimal negative space, utilizing the wood texture as a dense backdrop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grey and muted blue (wood planks and denim)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and ochre (skin tones, rusted metal, straw)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high local contrast; shadows are deep and highlights are punchy but textured.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy and industrial tones

letterConstructionRules: Flat terminals and uniform stroke width
Heavy erosion/grunge effect applied to edges and interiors of glyphs
Tight kerning to create a solid block of text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are 'stamped' with varying levels of opacity to simulate weathered paint on wood

composition.position: top-left of the main display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavily textured, large display font paired with a smaller, cleaner version of the same skeleton for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure.
Classic condensed sans-serif often used in country music branding.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and plaid shirt leaning against a weathered grey wood barn wall. Include a piece of rusted corrugated metal at the bottom. Apply a gritty, desaturated film grain filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed, uppercase sans-serif text across the center. Apply a heavy 'eroded' or 'stamp' texture to the text so the background wood grain appears to show through the white letters. Place a smaller, clean condensed subtitle above the first word.

verificationChecks: Is the main text distressed and weathered?
Does the text overlap the subject?
Is the color palette muted and rustic?
Is the background wood grain visible through the text texture?

adjustableVariables: intensity of the blue/brown color grade
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography looks like worn paint, not a digital overlay.
Check that the subject's hat does not get lost in the background texture.
Verify the rusted metal at the bottom adds to the composition without distracting.
Confirm the high-contrast lighting maintains detail in the shadows.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a gritty outdoor portrait with oversized, eroded condensed sans-serif type that acts as both a label and a textural element.
